description: ignorePaths lists generated copies only. Each path below is rewritten by scripts/sync_shared_lib.py, scripts/sync_synthetic_monitoring_variants.py or scripts/sync_alloy_variants.py (which generates alloy_host/ from alloy/), so a Renovate PR against one is reverted by the next sync.

alloy_host/Dockerfile is generated too, but deliberately left managed: it carries the same ALLOY_VERSION, base-debian and golang pins as alloy/Dockerfile, so Renovate edits both in the same branch and the generated copy still matches its source. ignorePaths cannot negate, so alloy_host/ is ignored by subdirectory rather than with alloy_host/**.

The source modules shared/reporter, synthetic_monitoring_shared/launcher and synthetic_monitoring_shared/ui must stay managed. A wildcard */reporter/** also matched shared/reporter, which silently took the module every App compiles from out of Renovate's reach and let a transitive CVE sit unproposed.

customManagers.description: Track the Grafana Alloy release pinned in the App Dockerfile. alloy/Dockerfile is the single source of truth for the version - alloy/tests/generate-config.test.sh parses it out of the same line - and alloy_host/Dockerfile, generated from it, is updated in the same branch so gen-check stays green.
Track the yamllint release `just lint` runs through uvx. Unpinned, uvx caches whatever was latest on first use, so lint behaviour drifts between a developer machine, a cloud agent and CI.

packageRules.description: Keep the App build, manifest, and multi-architecture matrix actions on one Home Assistant builder release.
Keep Home Assistant metadata and App discovery helpers on one actions revision.
Keep the development container on the Home Assistant supported major
